Instrument.name: The Radio Science Subsystem (RSS) for Deep Impact
Instrument.description: The Radio Science Subsystem (RSS) of the Deep Impact spacecraft included both the telecommunications equipment on the spacecraft itself as well as the Deep Space Network (DSN) tracking stations communicating with the spacecraft. The spacecraft component operated at X-band frequencies only. The flight hardware included two low and one high gain X-band antennas, two Small Deep Space Transponders (SDSTs), and a pair of Traveling Wave Tube Amplifiers (TWTAs). The spacecraft did not include any S-band capabilities, limiting the ability to estimate and remove plasma effects from the radio data.
